| [ADR-103](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-103.md) | A line rightful-power is added beside dependence-and-domination and organizational-normativity, without moving any entry out of them: its root questions carry it first, and an entry carries it when it takes part in its argument | On the owner's decision of 2026-11-18 ("go ahead with the line, first-line option"), the closed lines vocabulary gains rightful-power, "Rightful power: restriction, answerability and rights", for the argument filed from the exchange "Assess Depp Heard Abuse". | [ADR-109](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-109.md) | The record keeps its research opportunities as LEADs, plans to advance a question or claim by any method, with a status for whether each is still worth following and a stage for how far it is worked out; and a question may presuppose another | The record's research opportunities were scattered: proposed-study CASEs (54, 28 of them bearing on no question), "What would answer it?" prose on 264 of 451 open questions, and proposed tests in dated notes. Nothing said which were still wanted, how far each was worked out, or which waited on which, and an opportunity that was not an experiment had no form at all. The owner asked on 2026-11-19 for a better way to represent this backlog, and supported dependencies among questions. A new scheme, LEAD, holds a plan to advance a question or claim: by reading, conceptual or formal work, a study, a history, or working out how a question could be advanced at all. Its status (Open, Done, Dropped, Superseded) says whether it is still worth following; a separate `stage` (idea, specified, underway) how far it is worked out. It `advances` questions and claims, may be `operationalized_in` a CASE that holds its design, and may `presuppose` a lead or a question. Questions gain `presupposes`, after THEORY's ([ADR-029](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-029.md)). Rejected: a "What would advance it?" section on every question; decision gates on claims; more fields on CASE; a backlog file outside the record. | Proposed |
